g.text: Oil Spill Detection and Attribution System
From Satellite Imagery to Evidence-Based Vessel Attribution (SeaSentinel · SIH26143 · NTRO)
🔄 Feedback & Continuous Tuning: Parameter Calibration & Re-Analysis
• Test Suite: Pytest (9/9 unit tests passing)
• Real Sentinel-1 C-Band SAR satellite passes
• Real NOAA MarineCadastre AIS vessel data
• Real CMEMS & ERA5 wind & ocean current grids
• Gulf of Mexico (MC20) verified slick case
• Strait of Malacca congested choke point
• Arabian Sea Clean Control (zero false alarm)
• AIS Query Funnel: < 35 ms for 10k+ pings
• Wind Speed Window: 2.0 to 12.0 m/s optimal
• Low wind (< 2 m/s): Natural sea surface mirror
• High wind (> 14 m/s): Wave mixing emulsifies oil
• Thickness Ambiguity: SAR detects surface damp
• Requires optical S2 to distinguish thick vs sheen
• Unverified transponder gaps incur DR penalty
• Automated Satellite Tasking: Trigger SAR on
• coastal AIS route anomalies or transponder drops
• Edge Deployment: Porting to NVIDIA Jetson
